statements.basis: diagnosis_codes (I34.0 represents nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency)
statements.statement: The patient has a history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
An ambulatory cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) was ordered
The monitoring is for diagnostic assessment to evaluate for potential arrhythmias
The arrhythmia cannot be captured on a routine electrocardiogram given the intermittent nature of the episodes
The denial reason code is PR-204
